transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster (surface line y=299.5, 0 cm y=2751.5, 17.51 px/cm); boundaries printed on the right axis and every bar edge agrees with them. Hardness from bar left edges vs gridlines (I/K/P/1F/4F/F at 707/967/1227/1487/1747/2007 px, 260 px per class; thirds as +/-). Temperatures are break points of the unmarked red polyline (Douglas-Peucker on the line centre, +-0.1 C / +-0.5 cm), calibrated with x = 2115.5 + 46.80*T(C). Calibration check: the dashed air-temperature segment is vertical at x=2069 (-1.0 C) and the printed air temp is -1.0 C. Temperature line ends at 40 cm (no readings below). Red highlight lines (pure red, 8 px) lie directly below the 116 and 92 cm boundary lines, each spanning the bar width of the layer below (1F+ and 1F), so those layers get 'highlighted red'. Thin 117-116 MFcr bar (y 706-717) measured directly. Water content 'D' printed for every layer; no density column.
